unresolved_gaps: No located records establish comparable autonomous research projects active at all three named companies during the target period.
Related coding, browsing, and benchmark research does not establish identical development objectives.
Observed failures do not establish the claimed universal architectural cause.
No reliability threshold distinguishes partial web automation from the claimed autonomous research capability.
